description: Repository-local wire contract for the JSON object a Codex PostToolUse apply-patch maintenance hook reads from stdin. This is the canonical apply_patch subset used by the local owners, not a generic PostToolUse schema. Runtime validation is owned by validatePostToolUseInput in .codex/hooks/PostToolUse/skill-audit.mjs; keep the two in sync.

agent_id.description: Present only for tool calls made inside a subagent.

agent_type.description: Present only for tool calls made inside a subagent.

cwd.description: Session working directory; may be a repository subdirectory.

tool_response.description: Raw tool response; present but passed through without validation.

title: Codex PostToolUse apply-patch maintenance input
